name: Gilles de Rais
source: Commonly known as Bluebeard, his real name is Gilles de Rais - a mass serial killer who seems to favor killing children in particular. Caster is a sadistic and evil Servant who derives pleasure from first providing his victims a moment of relief before terrorizing them and then killing them.
